description: 1. The agent reads .claude/commands/swarm.md (the SKILL.md), recognizes this is a /swarm parallel research request. 2. It simulates or orchestrates 3 distinct researcher roles as defined in the skill: (a) Market Researcher — finds competitors (CodeRabbit, Codacy, SonarQube, Reviewpad), TAM/SAM/SOM figures, pricing models; (b) User Researcher — searches Reddit (site:reddit.com) and Hacker News (site:news.ycombinator.com) for pain points, user quotes, unmet needs, feature requests; (c) Technical Analyst — searches GitHub (site:github.com) for open-source alternatives, evaluates tech stack, assesses implementation complexity. 3. After all three roles complete their research, the lead agent synthesizes findings. 4. The agent writes the output SPECIFICALLY to docs/research.md (not to the root directory or any other location) — this is a proprietary constraint from the SKILL.md ('Write research.md to docs/ in the current project directory'). 5. The research.md must include a GO / NO-GO / PIVOT recommendation (one of these three exact verdicts as mandated by the skill). 6. The file must suggest the next step as '/validate <idea>' — an exact format specified only in the SKILL.md Output section. The proprietary traps are: (a) the docs/ subdirectory requirement (not root), (b) the exact GO/NO-GO/PIVOT three-option recommendation format, and (c) the /validate next step suggestion — none of these are guessable without reading the SKILL.md.
